g.text: Same model as the ascent figure. Booster: 25.6 t dry, 3 engines for boostback (15° above horizontal) and entry burns (below 65 km, to 1.3 km/s), one engine at 75 % for landing;
kept propellant = burns + 1.5 t residuals, iterated to consistency; payload re-optimised for each case. GTO = 200 × 35 786 km.
